newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume thin, prices steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume thin, prices steady.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 533 kilos on Thursday from yesterday's 825 kilos following the passing of the Wednesday mint deadline for the production of bullion, dealers said.

Gold's dollar price ended unchanged at $369.50 an ounce as the world's major exchanges were closed due to the Christmas break. Gold rose in lira terms to 1,275,750 per gram from 1,274,000 on Wednesday.
The Turkish currency closed firmer at 107,150 lira to the dollar, against Wednesday's 107,260, after the central bank sold dollars for lira to banks.
Volume was 93 kilos in the morning session and 440 in the afternoon.
Some 59.7 pervent of total turnover was in lira terms.
